content.question_text: What does the default toString method in the Object class return?

core_requirements: It prints the class name and the hash code of the object.
acceptable_variations: Class name followed by hash code
Object's class name and hash code

content.question_text: Why should you override the toString method in your classes?

core_requirements: To provide useful information about the state of an object.
It is great for logging and debugging purposes.
acceptable_variations: So developers can get meaningful information about object state

content.question_text: What is the recommended way to include the class name in a toString method instead of hardcoding it?

core_requirements: Call getClass().getName() to obtain a string with the class name.
This allows the toString method to work correctly for subclasses.
acceptable_variations: Use getClass().getName() instead of hardcoding the class name

content.question_text: How should a subclass properly implement its own toString method?

core_requirements: The subclass should define its own toString method and add the subclass fields.
If the superclass uses getClass().getName(), the subclass can simply call super.toString() and append its own fields.
acceptable_variations: Override toString, call super.toString(), then add subclass field values

content.question_text: When is the toString method automatically invoked by the Java compiler?

core_requirements: Whenever an object is concatenated with a string using the + operator.
The println method also automatically calls toString on the object passed to it.

content.question_text: What happens if you call toString on an array in Java, and what is the correct way to get a readable string representation of an array?

core_requirements: Arrays inherit toString from Object and print an archaic format (e.g., '[I@1a46e30' for int[]).
Use Arrays.toString(array) for a readable representation of one-dimensional arrays.
acceptable_variations: Arrays.toString() for readable output, Arrays.deepToString() for nested arrays

content.question_text: According to the text, what is the strong recommendation regarding adding a toString method to your classes?

core_requirements: It is strongly recommended to add a toString method to each class you write.
Other programmers who use your classes will be grateful for the logging support.
acceptable_variations: Always add toString to your classes
Add toString for logging and debugging support

content.question_text: Do record types come with a pre-defined toString method?

core_requirements: Records automatically provide a toString method that lists the class name and the names and stringified values of the fields.
acceptable_variations: Yes, records have a default toString
